name: LZHK: Ja tebja nenavizhu
source:
Lena, Zhenya, and Kir are ordinary college friends who occasionally spend time together. But Zhenya is in love with Lena, and gradually this feeling begins to grow into something more. This is not helped by a voice inside him called Toad, who is constantly influencing his brain. Will you be able to keep the balance between friendship or love... Or will one of the trio be destined to take the fatal step into the abyss?

[translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-4636]Anivisual[/url]]
